question: Does causal token-generated pair-rotation modulation outperform simpler conditioning at useful marginal storage and measured runtime?
insertion: A generated Mirror angle rotates consecutive residual-channel pairs before the FFN of one shared frozen causal Transformer block. A fresh angle is generated at each token from an observed causal prefix; no task/expert ID or teacher angle is supplied.
scope: Controlled synthetic teacher-distribution distillation, not natural-language training, not post-fit oracle delta reconstruction, not capacity or general compression proof.
selection: Source STATUS_BOARD selects MA-403; live ma-4 branch search found no MA-403 before a dedicated branch was created.

architecture.backbone: shared frozen random causal attention + residual FFN + output head
architecture.context: exclusive prefix normalized sum of attention residuals; strictly causal

data.teacher_targets: full categorical distributions; shared by all methods and charged as distillation supervision

train.seed_pairing: identical backbone, datasets and minibatch indices within world; initial adapter first-layer weights paired where shapes agree
train.frozen_prefix_cache: allowed for all training methods; end-to-end inference timing includes recomputation

evaluation.storage: actual custom lossless inference files containing all frozen backbone state, learned adapter/generator state, metadata, dtype and shapes
evaluation.incremental_storage: actual full file bytes minus actual same-backbone no-adapter file bytes; distinct from a total-model compression ratio

timing.operation: end-to-end sequence forward; not KV-cached decoding
timing.summary: median, min, max across repeats; interleave method order deterministically

gates.runtime_reference: fastest quality-qualified native control at each batch
gates.storage_reference: smallest quality-qualified native control; quality-qualified means within 0.01 nat/token of best native on both splits
gates.nonlearnable_upper: NOT_ESTABLISHED for that world; never evidence that Mirror universally fails

stopping: Run the entire preregistered development matrix. If any required gate fails or is unestablished, stop before generating any fresh world. No gate or seed retuning.
uncertainty: Report paired world-seed ranges, not population CI. Timing repeat SD/sqrt(7) is repeat-only standard uncertainty, k=2 is a descriptive expansion with no coverage claim. Scheduling/systematic error unquantified.

prior_art.PA64: arXiv:1903.07291 (SPADE spatially adaptive affine normalization); inspiration only, no reproduction of image synthesis

limitations: Shared random frozen backbone and deliberately controlled teacher families
Teacher soft targets are extra supervision
Known paired rotation/complex phase is not a novel mathematical operation
No pretrained checkpoint or external data download
